findings.description: No PNG visual evidence exists in poc/out/. RESULTS.md documents the pdf-to-img blocker and suggests manual conversion with ImageMagick or Poppler, but that conversion was never performed. Without PNGs, visual verification is incomplete. Reproduce: run ImageMagick or pdftoppm commands from README step 6, commit the PNGs.

Requirement ratings lack visual proof. Requirements (b), (c), (e), (g), (h), (i), (j) show PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL ratings but RESULTS.md states 'No Visual Inspection Performed'. The ratings appear to derive from code inspection (CSS properties, Typst syntax) rather than actual rendered output. Either open the PDFs manually and describe what you saw, or downgrade all appearance-related requirements to UNVERIFIED.

sample.json has nikud but no teamim. The JSON includes nikud characters (U+05B0–U+05C7: בְּרֵאשִׁית). Test Data Notes section says 'Teamim: Not included in test data'. Requirement (b) covers 'nikud and teamim' but only nikud was tested. Mark (b) as PARTIAL for nikud-only, or note that teamim testing is deferred pending authentic source text.

Determinism rating contradicts stated goal. Both engines marked NON-DETERMINISTIC. RESULTS.md notes PDFs may contain metadata timestamps. The instruction asks for determinism of layout (same break points), not binary PDF identity. If the PDF structure (text positions, page breaks) is identical but only metadata differs, that's deterministic layout with non-deterministic serialization. Clarify what was actually compared: PDF binary, or extracted text/layout structure.

Workaround cost estimates not justified. 'Baseline grid: 200-300 lines (High difficulty)' — how was this estimate derived? No references to similar projects, no breakdown, no prototyping. Either link to prior art that informs these numbers, or label them as rough estimates.

Font installation status unclear. README mentions Ezra SIL font but Typst shows 'unknown font family: ezra sil' warning. RESULTS.md notes 'Font fallback to system default, nikud quality unknown'. Was the font actually installed system-wide as the prerequisites require? If not, that's a setup failure, not an engine limitation.
